messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from PM postmortem INC-9001	 recurring circuit-breaker alerts kept paging on transient retries. We need a clear owner + timeline to tune thresholds and dedupe without losing accountability.
mike: Noted. Root cause was retries from the service mesh causing bursts across 7 hosts -> pages to infra oncall. Suggest short-term: raise threshold for fanout-based paging and add a dedupe key that respects owner_group.
sara: Agree. We must ensure every owner_group still gets at least one page when their members are involved. Proposal: dedupe key = (error_fingerprint, owner_group). Keep a per-key suppression that allows 1 pager per 15m per owner_group, but Slack-only for subsequent identical events within 5m.
elaine: To avoid hiding real outages, bypass suppression when distinct_hosts > 5 OR absolute_rate > 1000/min. Those should always page. Also add a deploy tag check so deploy-related noise can use wider suppression if team approves.
mike: Implementation sketch for alertproxy middleware (high-level):
```
fp = fingerprint(error_message)
owner = lookup_owner(resource)
if distinct_hosts >= 6 or rate > 1000/min:
  deliver = pager
else:
  key = fp + owner
  if seen_in_window(key, 15m) == false:
    deliver = pager
    mark_seen(key,15m)
  else:
    deliver = slack
    increment(metric: alerts.suppressed.count{owner})
```
We will sample suppressed events to a retention log for audit.
sara: Metrics to add: alerts.suppressed.count (tags: owner, service), alerts.paged.count, alerts.repaged_after_suppression.count. Also export alerts.suppression.window_last to monitor TTLs.
ops-bot: Reminder: oncall this week: sara primary, mike secondary. Use /incident link INC-9001 for tests.
elaine: Owners and ETAs: sara (alertproxy change + metrics + audit log) ETA Fri EOD; mike (runbook updates + rollback checklist + synthetic test harness) ETA Mon; elaine (canary plan + SLA guardrails) ETA Tue.
mike: I'll add a small synthetic job that hits the service mesh with a retry storm and measures pages per minute. Will post results in this thread.
sara: Also adding a label to alerts: pm_ticket=PM-5890 and owner_group so oncall can trace context without opening the postmortem. We'll include suppression_level annotation for clarity.
elaine: Rollout plan: 1) staging deploy + synthetic bursts (48h), 2) canary in us-west for 24h, 3) evaluate metrics for 72h before global. Revert criteria: repaged_after_suppression > 0.75% OR missed-critical-pages during canary.
mike: Quick PR snippet I'll include in the middleware repo README for operators:
```
# tuning knobs
suppression_window_minutes = 15
slack_only_window_minutes = 5
owner_page_quota = 1  # per suppression window
absolute_bypass_rate = 1000
host_fanout_bypass = 6
```
sara: I'll instrument dashboards: suppressed vs paged ratio by service, alerts.repaged_after_suppression trend, and a table of sampled suppressed events for audit.
ops-bot: Task created: ACT-9001-TUNE assigned to sara, mike, elaine.
elaine: Action items summary:
- sara: implement fingerprint + suppression cache, export metrics and audit logs (due Fri EOD)
- mike: synthetic retry harness, runbook + rollback checklist, attach PM-5890 to alerts (due Mon)
- elaine: canary scheduling + SLA guardrails + final go/no-go (due Tue)
We'll meet Tue 09:00 PT to review the canary results and sign off.
mike: One more ask	 can we add a metric counter that increments when suppression prevented a page but the suppressed event later led to an incident? alerts.suppressed.regressed.count. That helps catch false negatives.
sara: Good idea. I'll add that and a Grafana alert if regressed.count > 0.5% over 24h during canary.
elaine: Cool. Thanks team. Posting the action items to the postmortem ticket now. :thumbsup:
